items.context: @ChentoTrades (101.088 seguidores), en inglés, con imagen: lista los bear markets de máximo a piso (2013: −87%; 2017: −84%; 2021: −78%) y dice que este ciclo va $126.208 → $55.156 (−56%); su objetivo es $48K (−62%) y, si las caídas siguen achicándose, la próxima rondaría −70% (~$38K). Cierra: "Show me the bullish case, and I'll listen." Publicado hace ~25 min: 104 likes, 7 reposts, 28 respuestas, 7.250 vistas. Tema caídas y recuperación / ciclos.
items.suggested_text:
The shrinking-drawdown pattern is real, but depth is only half of the picture. The other half is time. In my Cycle Clock the 2011 cycle fell −92.7% and took 622 days to reclaim the high; 2013 fell −84.5% and needed 1,177 days. The shallower drop took almost twice as long to recover.

That's the part most bottom targets skip. A milder bear doesn't have to mean a faster one; in practice, less capitulation often means a longer grind, with price stuck in a range long enough to exhaust both sides.

So the real question for this cycle may not be whether $BTC sees $48K or $38K, but how long the market is willing to sit below $126K before anyone stops counting. https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2122375393776951738
